meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当你说要重构代码时，Claude 会先确认你的目标，再分析整个项目结构、找出相关文件和测试，然后逐步修改，每步都运行测试和类型检查，确保不弄坏现有功能。最后给你变更总结。
howto.when: 当你提到“refactor”、“cleanup”、“restructure”等触发词，或直接要求重构代码时触发。

say.text: 把 src/auth/handler.ts 里的验证逻辑提取成独立模块
say.note: Claude 会先分析依赖，再分步提取并验证。

say.text: 用 safe 策略重构整个项目，保持所有测试通过
say.note: 它会按阶段执行，每步验证测试。

say.text: 简化 AuthService 类的代码，先给我一份计划
say.note: 它先确认理解并生成计划再动手。

howto.what_en: When asked to refactor code, Claude confirms the goal, maps the project, finds related files and tests, then makes changes step by step, running tests and type checks after each step. It finishes with a summary of changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'refactor', 'cleanup', 'restructure', or ask to refactor code.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in src/auth/handler.ts into a separate module.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes dependencies, then extracts and verifies.

say_en.text: Refactor the whole project with the safe strategy and keep all tests passing.
say_en.note: It works in phases, verifying tests after each step.

say_en.text: Simplify the AuthService class, but show me a plan first.
say_en.note: It confirms understanding and plans before changing code.
